(Section context: Context `{S : @SymmetricMonoidal C}.)

Class SpecialCommutativeFrobenius (X : C) : Type := { scfa_commutative : @CommutativeFrobenius C _ X; mu_delta_id : mu ∘ delta ≈ id[X] }.  (* CommutativeFrobenius = Frobenius (commutative monoid + cocommutative comonoid + frob_law_left + frob_law_right) plus mu_commutative/delta_cocommutative — Def 6.52's nine equations *)

Definition canonical_tensor_mu {X Y : C} (MX : Monoid X) (MY : Monoid Y) : (X ⨂ Y) ⨂ (X ⨂ Y) ~> X ⨂ Y := bimap (@mu _ _ _ MX) (@mu _ _ _ MY) ∘ mid_swap X Y.  (* mid_swap X Y : (X⨂Y)⨂(X⨂Y) ~> (X⨂X)⨂(Y⨂Y), the middle-four interchange the book draws as the crossing wires *)

statement_record.book: A hypergraph category is a symmetric monoidal category (C, I, ⊗) in which every object X is equipped with a Frobenius structure (μ_X, δ_X, η_X, ε_X) in the sense of Definition 6.52, such that for all X, Y the four Frobenius maps on X ⊗ Y are the evident ones assembled from those on X and Y using the symmetry (four displayed string-diagram equations), and such that η_I = id_I = ε_I.
statement_record.intree: Class Hypergraph over `Context {C : Category}` + `Context `{S : @SymmetricMonoidal C}`: a field `scfa : forall X, SpecialCommutativeFrobenius X`, four tensor-coherence fields equating scfa_mu/eta/delta/epsilon at X ⨂ Y with canonical_tensor_mu/eta/delta/epsilon built through mid_swap, and four unit-coherence fields at I (scfa_unit_mu ≈ unit_left, scfa_unit_eta ≈ id[I], scfa_unit_delta ≈ unit_left⁻¹, scfa_unit_epsilon ≈ id[I]).

evidence.intree_statement: Program Instance Hypergraph_CompactClosed : @CompactClosed C S := {| dual := fun X => X; cc_unit := fun X => hcc_unit X (F := scfa X); cc_counit := fun X => hcc_counit X (F := scfa X); snake_left := hypergraph_snake_left; snake_right := hypergraph_snake_right |}.  (Section context: `{S : @SymmetricMonoidal C}, `{H : @Hypergraph C S}; hcc_unit X := scfa_delta F ∘ scfa_eta F, hcc_counit X := scfa_epsilon F ∘ scfa_mu F.)

Lemma hypergraph_snake_left (X : C) : to (@unit_left C _ X) ∘ bimap (hcc_counit X (F := scfa X)) id[X] ∘ from (@tensor_assoc C _ X X X) ∘ bimap id[X] (hcc_unit X (F := scfa X)) ∘ from (@unit_right C _ X) ≈ id[X].

Lemma hypergraph_snake_right (X : C) : to (@unit_right C _ X) ∘ bimap id[X] (hcc_counit X (F := scfa X)) ∘ to (@tensor_assoc C _ X X X) ∘ bimap (hcc_unit X (F := scfa X)) id[X] ∘ from (@unit_left C _ X) ≈ id[X].

statement_record.book: Hypergraph categories are self-dual compact closed categories, if we define the cup I → X ⊗ X to be η_X followed by δ_X and the cap X ⊗ X → I to be μ_X followed by ε_X. Proof: expand by definition, apply the Frobenius law in the middle (Exercise 6.67), then unitality, yielding a bare wire.
